column3: sqlite3.c sets it for clang's __atomic builtins

names the toolchain, not a behaviour; the guest reports its own COMPILER row (checked for presence only)
Darwin file-system locking styles chosen by statfs f_fstypename; the guest's files are Linux files behind machorun, so POSIX advisory locks (the Linux default) are used
os_unix.c turns locking styles on for __APPLE__ unless told otherwise, so the guest states =0 and sqlite3_compileoption_get reports it
blocking F_SETLKW with a timeout through machorun's fcntl is unmeasured

the amalgamation's pre-generated parser cannot enable it (sqlite.org: canonical sources only)
